title: Individual Contributions of Amido Acid Residues Tyr122, Ile168, and Asp173 to the Activity and Substrate Specificity of Human DNA Dioxygenase ABH2.
authors: Davletgildeeva, Anastasiia T; Tyugashev, Timofey E; Zhao, Mingxing; Kuznetsov, Nikita A; Ishchenko, Alexander A; Saparbaev, Murat; Kuznetsova, Aleksandra A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和动力学实验研究人DNA双加氧酶ABH2活性位点残基对底物识别的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作机制研究，但对象为修复酶而非转录因子，方法以MD为主，与TF-DNA课题部分相关。
abstract: Human Fe(II)/alpha-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase ABH2 plays a crucial role in the direct reversal repair of nonbulky alkyl lesions in DNA nucleobases, e.g., N(1)-methyladenine (m(1)A), N(3)-methylcytosine (m(3)C), and some etheno derivatives. Moreover, ABH2 is capable of a less efficient oxidation of an epigenetic DNA mark called 5-methylcytosine (m(5)C), which typically is a specific target of DNA dioxygenases from the TET family. In this study, to elucidate the mechanism of the substrate specificity of ABH2, we investigated the role of several active-site amino acid residues. Functional mapping of the lesion-binding pocket was performed through the analysis of the functions of Tyr122, Ile168, and Asp173 in the damaged base recognition mechanism. Interactions of wild-type ABH2, or its mutants Y122A, I168A, or D173A, with damaged DNA containing the methylated base m(1)A or m(3)C or the epigenetic marker m(5)C were analyzed by molecular dynamics simulations and kinetic assays. Comparative analysis of the enzymes revealed an effect of the substitutions on DNA binding and on catalytic activity. Obtained data clearly demonstrate the effect of the tested amino acid residues on the catalytic activity of the enzymes rather than the DNA-binding ability. Taken together, these data shed light on the molecular and kinetic consequences of the substitution of active-site residues for the mechanism of the substrate recognition.
abstract_zh: 人Fe(II)/α-酮戊二酸依赖性双加氧酶ABH2在DNA核碱基中非大体积烷基损伤的直接逆转修复中发挥关键作用，例如N(1)-甲基腺嘌呤（m(1)A）、N(3)-甲基胞嘧啶（m(3)C）及一些乙烯基衍生物。此外，ABH2能够以较低效率氧化一种称为5-甲基胞嘧啶（m(5)C）的表观遗传DNA标记，该标记通常是TET家族DNA双加氧酶的特定靶标。在本研究中，为阐明ABH2底物特异性的机制，我们探究了几个活性位点氨基酸残基的作用。通过分析Tyr122、Ile168和Asp173在损伤碱基识别机制中的功能，对损伤结合口袋进行了功能映射。通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和动力学实验，分析了野生型ABH2或其突变体Y122A、I168A或D173A与含有甲基化碱基m(1)A或m(3)C或表观遗传标记m(5)C的损伤DNA的相互作用。对酶的对比分析揭示了这些替换对DNA结合和催化活性的影响。获得的数据明确表明，所测试的氨基酸残基对酶催化活性的影响大于对DNA结合能力的影响。综合来看，这些数据揭示了活性位点残基替换对底物识别机制的分子和动力学后果。
